messages:
sec-bot: npm audit found 2 vulnerabilities in repo console/ui:
- HIGH: lodash (prototype-pollution) via markdown-renderer -> fixed in 4.17.21
- MODERATE: tar (path-traversal) in CI toolchain -> fixed in 4.4.15
More details: https://npmjs.com/advisories (automated) :eyes:

maria_devsec: bumping this into triage thread — curious which of these actually land in the runtime bundle vs only in CI/devtools?

alex_frontend: quick check — lodash is pulled transitively by our markdown rendering stack (remark + rehype plugins). webpack tree-shakes some utils but I can see `_.merge`/`_.defaults` kept in vendor chunk. so runtime exposure likely.

taylor_build: tar looks like a dev-only transitive (used by extract-tar via cache tooling). not shipped to prod, but still a supply-chain risk for CI images.

samir_sec: priority: lodash fix first (HIGH). plan: patch console-ui to force lodash@4.17.21, run bundle-scan + fuzz tests, and ship a patch release. For tar, update our build images / CI container and bump dev deps.

priya_platform: lockfile churn note — previous mass lockfile bumps caused flaky installs and long review cycles. can we apply a minimal surface fix (override/resolutions) to reduce churn?

jordan_devex: we can use `overrides` in package.json (npm v8+) to pin the transitive to the fixed versions, which gets us a small PR. example:```json
{
  "overrides": {
    "lodash": "4.17.21",
    "tar": "4.4.15"
  }
}
```That keeps diffs tiny. I can draft Renovate config after.

alex_frontend: I can open the PR to add `overrides` + run `npm ci && npm run build && node ./scripts/bundle-scan.js` and paste the bundle-reports here. will include unit + e2e smoke.

samir_sec: add exploitability check: does our runtime accept untrusted JSON that could reach vulnerable lodash call paths? if yes, escalate to incident response and opt for immediate hotfix.

alex_frontend: quick grep shows markdown input comes from user-generated content but we sanitize through our renderer. still, better to patch now rather than rely on sanitizers.

priya_platform: for tar (CI-only) I'll push updated build images with patched tar in base image and run a canary of pipeline. that avoids touching lockfile if we want to be conservative.

maria_devsec: ok action plan summary: 1) alex opens small PR with `overrides` to pin lodash+tar 2) run bundle-scan + fuzz + smoke e2e 3) samir to review security impact + CISO notif if fuzz shows exploitability 4) priya updates CI images for tar 5) jordan drafts Renovate + longer-term dep hygiene doc.

jordan_devex: I'll create two small PR templates: one for "security transitive override" (tiny diff, single commit) and one for "devdep CI image update" so reviewers know expected scope.

samir_sec: mark CVEs as P1 for lodash patch work, P3 for tar in CI (since not runtime-exposed).

alex_frontend: opening PR now — expect `1795026789` CI run, will post results. :shipit: 

maria_devsec: thanks team. please tag this thread when PRs created. I'll update tracking sheet (security-triage) and close once patch validated. :white_check_mark:
